steps.title: Check official sources for new laws and rules on a topic
Extract each new rule's clauses, dates, definitions and duties
Write a plain-language summary that cites a clause for every point
Decide whether the reviewed summary is delivered (a person)

value.summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for watching official public sources for new laws and rules on a topic: reading them only through permitted official access, extracting their clauses, writing a summary that cites a clause for every point and is marked not legal advice, having a different worker review every citation, and delivering it only when a person decides.
value.title: Policy and law watch
